tei:div.tei:p: 71) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur sgrub zab mo'i drag bskul ye shes me phreng bzhugs: 72) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

o rgyan he ru ka la bdud: phyi rabs rjes 'jug chos mdzad rnams: yang gsang snying po'i don rtogs phyir: rim gnyis lam mchog nyams blangs nas: 'grub rtags mngon du bsnyes pa'i tshe: log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba'i thabs: dbyings nas bde gshegs rgyal ba yi: thugs dam gnyen po skul byed ni: ye shes me phreng 'di ru bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: gtor ma sha khrag rgya mtshor bsgyur: de nyid gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi: bla tshe srog dang dbyer med du: 'gugs gzhug bya zhing gnyis med bstim: zag med ye shes rdzas su dmigs: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: mthing nag gru 73)gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: rig stong bde chen rgyas 'debs yum dang 'khril: gnyis med zung 'jug rol pa'i skur ston pa: bzhengs shig thugs dam gnyen po gnad nas bskul: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang: 'gags med thugs rje'i rol pas skur bzhengs shig: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: hūm̐ bh+yo: shar phyogs zhi ba lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas: dpal 74)chen khro rgyal badz+ra kī la ya: bzhengs shig thugs dam gnyen po gnad nas bskul: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: me long ye shes klong nas skur bzhengs shig: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: hūm̐ bh+yo: lho phyogs rgyas pa lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen khro rgyal rat+na kī la ya: bzhengs shig= rnam dag= mnyam nyid ye shes= dam rdzas= dgra bgegs dam sri= hūm̐ bh+yo: nub phyogs dbang gi dkyil 'khor chen po nas: dpal chen khro rgyal pad+ma kī la ya: bzhengs shig= rnam dag= sor rtogs ye shes= dam rdzas= dgra bgegs dam sri=

byang phyogs drag po'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: dpal chen khro rgyal karma kī la ya: bzhengs shig= rnam dag= hūm̐ bh+yo: bya grub ye shes chen po'i klong nas bzhengs: dam rdzas= dgra bgegs dam sri= hūm̐ bh+yo: steng gi phyogs nas dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i lha: khro rgyal hūm̐ mdzad yab yum thugs dam bskulaḥ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang: thugs rje thabs mkhas khro bo'i skur bzhengs la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i 75)gtor ma 'di 'bul bzhes: dgra bgegs sri ngan 'dul ba'i dus la babs: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas dgregs= rnam rgyal yab yum thugs dam gnad nas bskul: rnam dag chos dbyings sogs gong ltar 'gres: hūm̐: shar lho'i phyogs= khro rgyal dbyu+ug sngon yab yum thugs dam bskul: rnam dag= hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas= khro rgyal gshin rje yab yum= rnam dag= hūm̐: lho nub phyogs= khro rgyal mi g.yo yab yum= rnam dag= hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas= khro rgyal rta mgrin yab yum= rnam dag= hūm̐: nub byang phyogs nas= khro chen 'dod rgyal yab yum= rnam dag= hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas= khro rgyal bdud 'khyil yab yum= rnam dag= hūm̐: byang shar phyogs nas= khams gsum rnam rgyal yab yum= rnam dag= hūm̐ bh+yo: 'og gi phyogs nas= khro rgyal stobs chen yab yum= rnam dag= hūm̐ bh+yo: dpal chen sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i sras dang ni: pho nya za gsod khra thabs sgo skyong bcas: dbang phyug ma sring dpal gyi bka' srung tshogs: ma g.yel 76)thugs dam gnyen po gnad nas bskul: rnam dag chos kyi= hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: sprul pa chen po'i= phyag brnyan chen po'i dus= las byed pho nya'i= mthu rtsal phyung ba'i= dgra bgegs brlag pa'i= ngas ni byang chub bsgrub pa la: dam nyams dgra bos bsgrub ma ster: do bsdo phod btsugs brnyas bcol nas: dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me 'di: dam nyams rnams kyis bsnubs la nye:

bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku la bsdos: dge 'dun 'dus sde thabs kyis bshig: chos sgrub yongs la 'tshe byed cing: nyes med sems can sdug la gtad: rnal 'byor mched lcam sun phyungs shing: mi dge sna tshogs thabs kyis bskul: de 'dra'i gnod sbyor byed pa yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can rnams: mkhyen ldan thugs kyis mi dgongs sam: thugs rje'i nus pa shugs bskyed la: ma g.yel thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dgra bgegs yan par ma shor bar: log 'dren 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes brjod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par nges: 77) zab bo phyi rabs skal ldan nyams su longs: rigs ldan chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i dpal du shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis thub par srungs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang bu slob rnams kyi bzhed skong du kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos ser dgon dben gnas mtshams khrod 'od gsal ljongs kyi nye 'dabs nas nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// 78)
